title: Gallery Content Slider
description:
## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-0">:person_with_crown:</custom> User Story

As a user, I want a responsive gallery content slider that can showcase different types of content components with flexible styling options

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-1">:brain:</custom> Assumptions

* Users will primarily interact with the slider on product pages, landing pages, and promotional sections
* The majority of users will access the slider on mobile devices
* Increased engagement through interactive content presentation
* Reduced bounce rates due to improved content accessibility
* Higher conversion rates through better visual storytelling

---

## <custom data-type="emoji" data-id="id-2">:clipboard:</custom> Requirements

The gallery slider should support:

* Multiple content / component types
* Responsive design that adapts to different screen sizes and orientations
* Different alignment options that influence navigation position
* Optimized visibility for different background types:

    * Light backgrounds
    * Dark backgrounds
    * Bright/high-contrast backgrounds
    
* Gallery should be fully responsive across all device sizes
* Navigation elements (arrows, dots, numbers) should:

    * Be clearly visible on all background types
    * Adapt their color scheme based on background selection
    * Support touch gestures on mobile devices
    * Can be chosen by the user:
    
        * default is bullet navigation for the bottom navigation
        * no inidicator (just buttons)
        * numbers
        
    
* Content components should:

    * Load efficiently without performance impact
    * Support various aspect ratios
    * Maintain quality across different screen resolutions
    * Should adapt in height to the highest item in the slider
    
* Accessibility requirements:

    * Keyboard navigation support
    * Screen reader compatibility
    * ARIA labels for all interactive elements
    

---
